title: Ombudsman finds former Bohol exec guilty of ‘serious dishonesty’

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman has found former Bohol provincial board member Vierna Mae Boniel-Maglasang guilty of “serious dishonesty,” thereby imposing a penalty of dismissal from service. In a news release on Thursday, the agency said it also imposed on Maglasang the accessory penalties of cancellation of eligibility, perpetual disqualification from holding public office, being barred from taking civil service examinations, and forfeiture of her retirement benefits. The case stemmed from a complaint filed by Bohol 3rd district Board Member Dionisio Joseph Balite, alleging that Maglasang used 100 liters of gasoline allocated for a government vehicle in […]...
